sloka: ततः किलकिलाशब्दं शुश्रावासन्नमम्बरे ।हनुमत्कर्मदृप्तानां नर्दतां काननौकसाम् ।किष्किन्धामुपयातानां सिद्धिं कथयतामिव ।। ५.६४.३३ ।।।।
transliteration: tataḥ kilakilāśabdaṁ śuśrāvāsannamambare ।hanumatkarmadṛptānāṁ nardatāṁ kānanaukasām ।kiṣkindhāmupayātānāṁ siddhiṁ kathayatāmiva ।। 5.64.33 ।।।।

translations.english: "You are extremely valiant and it is unbecoming of you to be anxious at this time Rama. Just then chatterings of the monkeys were heard from the sky as they roared in pride talking of Hanuman's achievement. Having successfully completed the errand, they have arrived at Kishkinda.
